unlisted_practices: Iterative human-in-the-loop prompt refinement guided by an error ontology for LLM information extraction
Precise task and goal articulation with interdisciplinary collaboration before building LLM extraction pipelines

screen.reason: Empirical study developing and validating an LLM-based pipeline for clinical information extraction from pathology reports using retrospective data. While it discusses iterative prompt refinement and error analysis, it primarily reports model extraction accuracy rather than an experimental test of an organizational deployment safeguard.
